description: For nearly 40 years, Legends Home has built its reputation on doing things the right way. From our Arizona manufacturing floor to our global sourcing network, we focus on quality, speed, and reliability so our dealers can count on us every time. name: Legere Group Ltd
description: Legere is a manufacturer of commercial and institutional millwork, as well as your turnkey provider of interior architectural metal and glass, stretch fabric, and stone. We have been fabricating and installing millwork since 1975. We provide millwork, metal, glass, stone, and stretch fabric to project locations extending from Northern, NJ to Boston, MA. As one of the largest full service custom architectural millwork manufacturers in the U.S., we focus on large scopes of work that range in value from $1 million to over $12 million. Our key to success is our continued pursuit of excellence, driven by our desire to produce what others deem the impossible. Whether your project requires just millwork items, or a complete package of millwork, glass, metal, stone, and stretch fabric, we are here to help you through the process of making a concept a reality. Don’t forget to ask us about our experience with IPD design build projects and our FSC® products.
